# Available modules


The overview below shows which NONMEM installations are available per HPC-UGent Tier-2 cluster, ordered based on software version (new to old).

To start using NONMEM, load one of these modules using a `module load` command like:

```shell
module load NONMEM/7.6.0-GCC-13.3.0-MPICH-4.2.2
```
